Key ResponsibilitiesDispensing & Compounding: Review prescriptions for legality, accuracy, and therapeutic appropriateness before compounding or dispensing drugs. Patient Counseling: Educate patients on how to take their medications, appropriate storage, potential side effects, and over-the-counter alternatives. Safety Monitoring: Screen patients for drug allergies, medical conditions, and potential adverse interactions between multiple drugs.
